def: Having or prompted by wisdom or discernment.
ex1: A wise leader.
ex2: A wise and perceptive comment.

def: Hope for; have a wish.
alt: Prefer or wish to do something.
ex1: I wish I could go home now.

def: Used to show a relationship meaning together with, using, having, or affected by something.
ex1: She cut the paper with scissors.

def: Pull back or move away or backward.
alt: Withdraw from active participation.
ex1: The enemy withdrew.
ex2: The limo pulled away from the curb.

def: Used to show a relationship meaning inside a place, range, limit, or period.
ex1: Please reply within three days.

def: Used to show a relationship meaning not having, using, or including someone or something.
ex1: He left without his phone.

def: Be a witness to.
alt: Perceive or be contemporaneous with.
ex1: She witnessed the accident and had to testify in court.

def: An adult female person (as opposed to a man).
ex1: The woman kept house while the man hunted.

def: Have a wish or desire to know something.
alt: Place in doubt or express doubtful speculation.
ex1: He wondered who had built this beautiful church.

def: Extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers.
ex1: A fantastic trip to the Orient.
ex2: The film was fantastic!

def: The hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees.
alt: The trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area.
ex1: The wood was stored safely.

def: Made or consisting of (entirely or in part) or employing wood.
ex1: A wooden box.
ex2: An ancient cart with wooden wheels.

def: A unit of language that native speakers can identify.
ex1: Words are the blocks from which sentences are made.
ex2: He hardly said ten words all morning.

def: Activity directed toward making or doing something.
alt: A product produced or accomplished through the effort or activity or agency of a person or thing.
ex1: She checked several points needing further work.

def: A person who works at a specific occupation.
ex1: He is a good worker.

def: Actively engaged in paid work.
alt: Adequate for practical use; especially sufficient in strength or numbers to accomplish something.
ex1: The working population.
ex2: The ratio of working men to unemployed.

def: Buildings for carrying on industrial labor.
ex1: They built a large plant to manufacture automobiles.

def: Small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done.
alt: A brief intensive course for a small group; emphasizes problem solving.
ex1: She used the workshop carefully.

def: Everything that exists anywhere.
alt: People in general; especially a distinctive group of people with some shared interest.
ex1: They study the evolution of the universe.
ex2: The biggest tree in existence.

def: Afflicted with or marked by anxious uneasiness or trouble or grief.
ex1: Too upset to say anything.
ex2: Spent many disquieted moments.

def: Be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy.
alt: Be concerned with.
ex1: I worry about my job.

def: Worthy of being treated in a particular way.
alt: Having a specified value.
ex1: An idea worth considering.
ex2: The deserving poor.

def: An auxiliary or modal verb used for imagined situations, polite requests, past habits, or the future viewed from the past.
ex1: Would you like some tea?

def: An injury to living tissue (especially an injury involving a cut or break in the skin).
ex1: The wound remained unchanged.

def: Arrange or fold as a cover or protection.
alt: Arrange or or coil around.
ex1: Wrap the baby before taking her out.
ex2: Wrap the present.

def: Produce a literary work.
alt: Communicate or express by writing.
ex1: She composed a poem.
ex2: He wrote four novels.

def: Writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay).
ex1: The writer spoke to the group.

def: The act of creating written works.
alt: The work of a writer; anything expressed in letters of the alphabet (especially when considered from the point of view of style and effect).
ex1: Writing was a form of therapy for him.
ex2: It was a matter of disputed authorship.

def: Not correct; not in conformity with fact or truth.
alt: Contrary to conscience or morality or law.
ex1: An incorrect calculation.
ex2: The report in the paper is wrong.

def: A unit of length equal to 3 feet; defined as 91.44 centimeters; originally taken to be the average length of a stride.
alt: The enclosed land around a house or other building.
ex1: The yard increased this year.

def: An expression an informal way to say “yes”.
ex1: Yeah, that sounds good.

def: A period of time containing 365 (or 366) days.
ex1: She is 4 years old.
ex2: In the year 1920.

def: Utter a sudden loud cry.
alt: Utter or declare in a very loud voice.
ex1: She cried with pain when the doctor inserted the needle.
ex2: I yelled to her from the window but she couldn't hear me.

def: Of the color intermediate between green and orange in the color spectrum; of something resembling the color of an egg yolk.
ex1: The situation seemed yellow.

def: An expression used to give a positive answer or show agreement.
ex1: Yes, I agree.

def: The day immediately before today.
ex1: It was in yesterday's newspapers.

def: Used to connect clauses; it connects a surprising contrast.
ex1: The task was difficult, yet she completed it.

def: Be the cause or source of.
alt: End resistance, as under pressure or force.
ex1: He gave me a lot of trouble.
ex2: Our meeting afforded much interesting information.

def: Used to refer to the person or people being spoken to.
ex1: You can sit here.

def: (used of living things especially persons) in an early period of life or development or growth.
ex1: Young people.

def: Used before a noun to mean belonging to or connected with the person or people being spoken to.
ex1: Your idea is interesting.

def: Used to refer to something that belongs to the person or people being spoken to.
ex1: This seat is yours.

def: Used when the person being spoken to is both the person doing and receiving an action.
ex1: You should give yourself a break.

def: A young person (especially a young man or boy).
ex1: The youth spoke to the group.

def: A locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features.
ex1: We visited the zone last year.
